messages.text: Almeraq storms to brilliant Sprint Cup success

metadata.summary: Almeraq left an off-day at Newmarket clearly in the rearview mirror with a dominating victory in the Betfair Sprint Cup at Haydock Park.
metadata.content: Haydock: Almeraq storms to brilliant Sprint Cup success for Haggas | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to content Haydock: Almeraq storms to brilliant Sprint Cup success for Haggas Almeraq, Tom Marquand and William Haggas tasted Sprint Cup success at Haydock, with the Queen Elizabeth II Jubilee Stakes hero bouncing back from July Cup disappointment in some style. Saturday 5 September 2026 17:14, UK Image: Almeraq Almeraq left an off-day at Newmarket clearly in the rearview mirror with a dominating victory in the Betfair Sprint Cup at Haydock Park. Last year's winner Big Mojo flew out of the stalls and set the early pace alongside Marvelman, before the race began to get serious two furlongs out. Paborus had travelled sweetly when he arrived on the scene - but as soon as Almeraq began to assert in the hands of regular pilot Tom Marquand it was all over, as the 9-4 favourite turned on the afterburners to leave the field in his wake, powering away for a four-and-a-quarter-length victory. Victory completed a remarkable turnaround for the William Haggas-trained four-year-old, who suffered a horror fall in a sprint almost a year ago to the day which effectively ended the riding career of Jim Crowley.
